quotes.text: Saul was anointed King over Israel, and he was a great polygamist, but he did not please the Lord, and the Lord rejected him, and allowed the Phillistines to array themselves against tho house of Israel ; and David, a stripling of the family of Jesse, delivered his people out of the hand of their enemies. Saul wits envious towards David, and sought to take his life, but the Lord preserved him,…
